FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS
BMS BLOCK–II, SOUTH CAMPUS, SECTOR-25, PANJAB UNIVERSITY,
CHANDIGARH-160014
Advertisement for one post of Project Technical Support–III
Applications are invited for one (01) positions of Project Technical Support–III in the Indian Council of Medical
Research (ICMR) sponsored research project entitled “Machine Learning and AI-Guided Design and Validation
of Cost-Effective Next-Generation Antimicrobial Peptides Against Multidrug Resistant Pathogens”
sanctioned to the undersigned.
No. of positions: One (01)
Essential Qualifications: Candidates must possess a three years B.Sc/graduate degree with three years’ experience
OR M.Sc./PG degree with a minimum of 55 percent marks in
Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Allied fields.
“Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/other national entrance test conducted by Government of India will be
preferred”.
Desirable Experience: Prior knowledge of molecular modelling, software, biomolecular simulations, various
microbiology, biochemical and spectrophotometric assays, cell culture and molecular biology techniques.
Emoluments/Fellowship: The selected candidate will be paid a stipend of Rs. 28,000 + 5600 (20% HRA).
Duration: Initial appointment for one year, extendable up to 2 years based on performance. The position is
temporary and co-terminus with the project.
Age Limit: 35 years
Other relaxations as per ICMR and Panjab University norms are applicable.
How to apply:
Candidates fulfilling the above criteria may submit their application (on plain paper) to the undersigned along with
a detailed resume (with email, address and contact number), attested copies of certificates, and work experience or
publications by 23rd October, 2026. The date and venue of the interview shall be conveyed via email or phone to
the eligible candidates. No separate call letter will be issued for the interview.
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with the project.
Sd/-
Prof. Avneet Saini
Principal Investigator
Department of Biophysics
Panjab University, Chandigarh- 160014
Email: avneet@pu.ac.in
